about: The Break tab's moves (docs/features/break.md, Exercises). Titles and texts are Froonty's own words. kind: stretch | move | eyes | breath. posture: seated (can be done sitting) or standing (needs standing up). discreet: can be done unnoticed in a video call. sides: done on each side in turn. art: where the picture comes from, in order of preference: workoutlabs (fetched by tools/fetch-break-art.py into third_party/break-art, not in the repository), workrave (exercises/images, GPL-3.0-or-later), drawn (features/break/drawn.js).

moves.title: Neck side tilt
moves.text: Sit tall. Tilt your head toward one shoulder until you feel a gentle stretch along the other side of your neck. Hold, then change sides.

moves.title: Neck turn
moves.text: Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder, hold briefly, then turn to the other side. Keep your shoulders still.

moves.title: Chin tuck
moves.text: Sit tall and draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. Hold a few seconds, relax, and repeat.

moves.title: Shoulder rolls
moves.text: Roll your shoulders up, back and down in slow circles, then the other way.

moves.title: Shoulder shrugs
moves.text: Lift both shoulders toward your ears, hold a moment, then let them drop and relax. Repeat.

moves.title: Cross-body shoulder stretch
moves.text: Bring one arm across your chest and gently pull it closer with the other hand, at the upper arm. Hold, then change arms.

moves.title: Overhead arm stretch
moves.text: Raise one arm, bend the elbow so the hand drops behind your head, and gently press the elbow with the other hand. Hold, then change arms.

moves.title: Chest opener
moves.text: Clasp your hands behind your back, or hold the back of the chair. Lift your chest and draw your shoulders back and down. Hold and breathe.

moves.title: Upper back stretch
moves.text: Clasp your hands in front of you at shoulder height, round your upper back and push your hands away. Hold and breathe.

moves.title: Seated twist
moves.text: Sit tall with your feet flat. Turn your upper body to one side, holding the chair lightly. Hold, then turn the other way.

moves.title: Side bend
moves.text: Sit tall and lean gently to one side, letting that arm slide down toward the floor. Hold, then change sides.

moves.title: Wrist stretch, palm up
moves.text: Hold one arm out, palm up, and with the other hand gently bend the fingers down and back. Hold, then change hands.

moves.title: Wrist stretch, palm down
moves.text: Hold one arm out, palm down, and with the other hand gently bend the hand down toward you. Hold, then change hands.

moves.title: Open and close your hands
moves.text: Spread your fingers wide and hold, then make a soft fist and hold. Repeat a few times.

moves.title: Prayer stretch
moves.text: Press your palms together in front of your chest and slowly lower your hands, palms still together, until you feel a gentle stretch in your wrists.

moves.title: Seated leg stretch
moves.text: Sit near the edge of the chair, straighten one leg with the heel on the floor, and lean forward from the hips with a straight back. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Ankle circles
moves.text: Lift one foot and draw slow circles with the ankle, both ways. Then the other foot.

moves.title: Standing thigh stretch
moves.text: Stand by your desk and hold it for balance. Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you, knees together. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Hip stretch
moves.text: Step one foot back into a short lunge, tuck your hips under and feel a stretch at the front of the back hip. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Calf raises
moves.text: Stand holding the desk, rise onto your toes, then lower slowly. Repeat.

moves.title: Sit to stand
moves.text: Stand up from your chair without using your hands, then sit down slowly. Repeat a few times.

moves.title: March on the spot
moves.text: Stand and march on the spot, lifting your knees and swinging your arms.

moves.title: Arm circles
moves.text: Stand with your arms out to the sides and draw small circles, forward and then backward.

moves.title: Wrist circles
moves.text: Make loose fists and draw slow circles with your wrists, both ways.

moves.title: Seated hip stretch
moves.text: Sit tall and rest one ankle on the other knee. Lean forward a little from the hips with a straight back until you feel a stretch in the hip. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Seated leg lifts
moves.text: Sit tall and straighten one knee to lift the foot, hold a moment, and lower it. Repeat, then the other leg.

moves.title: Wall push-ups
moves.text: Stand an arm's length from a wall with your hands on it at shoulder height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then push back. Repeat slowly.

moves.title: Calf stretch
moves.text: Hands on the desk or a wall, step one foot back and press the heel down, back knee straight, until you feel a stretch in the calf. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Knee hug
moves.text: Stand by the desk for balance, lift one knee and hug it gently toward your chest. Hold, then change legs.

moves.title: Walk
moves.text: Get up and walk: to get water, along a corridor, up and down the stairs.

moves.title: Drink some water
moves.text: Get up and get a glass of water.

moves.title: Look far away
moves.text: Look at something at least 6 m (20 ft) away, out of a window if you can, and blink.

moves.title: Follow the dot
moves.text: Keep your head still and follow the dot with your eyes, slowly.

moves.title: Eye circles
moves.text: Keep your head still and follow the dot around the circle with your eyes.

moves.title: Up and down
moves.text: Keep your head still; look up, then down, following the dot.

moves.title: Left and right
moves.text: Keep your head still; look left, then right, following the dot.

moves.title: Near and far
moves.text: Hold a finger about 25 cm in front of your eyes. Look at it, then at something far away, as the target changes.

moves.title: Blink
moves.text: Blink fully and slowly, about ten times.

moves.title: Palming
moves.text: Rub your hands warm, close your eyes and cover them with your cupped palms, without pressing. Rest.

moves.title: Box breathing
moves.text: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4 and hold for 4, with the circle. Breathe gently; stop if you feel dizzy.

moves.title: Slow breathing
moves.text: Breathe in for 5 and out for 5, with the circle. Breathe gently; stop if you feel dizzy.
